headline: Nine degrees as the lamps thin.
body: Temperature holds near nine degrees under a partly covered sky. A light south-west wind moves at five kilometres an hour; pressure stands at one thousand twenty-nine and stays steady. The streets remain dry as the last of the night lamps begin to fade.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: partly cloudy, 9°C, SW 5 km/h, pressure 1029 steady

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: dry paving; lamps starting to dim

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: civil dawn just passed; sunrise in twenty minutes
